end.summary:
Named ants and earthworms as soil animals; identified some additional small soil animals with prompting.
Discussed that earthworm tunnels allow air and water into soil; Pihu partly restated this idea.
Discussed how soil animals break dead leaves into smaller pieces and help form rich soil.
Earthworm-as-harmful-pest misconception remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming soil animals and explaining how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil. Pihu partly connected tunnels with water moving into soil and described leaves breaking into small pieces, but continued to mix up earthworms with harmful pests. At home, look at a leaf or garden patch together and ask Pihu to explain one helpful job of earthworms and one job of soil animals with a simple drawing.
